title.zh: DeepSeek、MiniMax完成AI技术出口登记，开源和海外授权已获放行
title.en: DeepSeek、MiniMax完成AI技术出口登记，开源和海外授权已获放行

current_state.zh: DeepSeek and MiniMax became the first Chinese AI labs to complete registration under China's new AI technology export management system, securing clearance for open-source releases and overseas licensing while a temporary registration regime remains in force ahead of the final catalogue.
current_state.en: DeepSeek and MiniMax became the first Chinese AI labs to complete registration under China's new AI technology export management system, securing clearance for open-source releases and overseas licensing while a temporary registration regime remains in force ahead of the final catalogue.
